costume.name: Fortune Teller
costume.description: An ivory blouse and flowing black skirt, finished with blue and gold coins for a theatrical midnight oracle.
costume.alt: Ivory billowy blouse, long black skirt, blue coin hip scarf and black boots.

pieces.name: Ivory billowy shirt
pieces.styleNotes: Loose light shirt with a ruffled front and cuffs. White options approximate the reference ivory shade.

matches.reason: White rather than ivory. Polyester shirt has a high collar, three front ruffle rows, cuff ruffles, and white/silver buttons. Shirt only. Feed exposes positive inventory for all four listed sizes.

Ivory shirt with ruffles and lace-up neckline; shirt only. Only Small is available at $12; sold-out Medium has a different price. Made in USA. Merchant advertises same-day US dispatch before 5pm EST Monday-Friday, excluding holidays.

White cotton-linen shirt includes detachable lace-edged neck jabot and adjustable lace cuffs. White differs from ivory. Listed sizes have physical stock; S/M 42 is sold out and excluded. Other pictured clothing is excluded. Merchant FAQ states normal 24-hour packing for fully stocked orders; no delivery date promised.

pieces.name: Long black skirt
pieces.styleNotes: A flowing dark skirt beneath the ivory blouse. Real choices are black rather than the reference midnight navy. No waistcoat is needed.
queries: black Victorian maxi skirt layered ruffles

matches.reason: One deep black lace maxi skirt with cascading ruffled tiers, embroidered detail, irregular hem and elastic drawstring waist. Closer layered texture than the plain walking skirt, but sheer lace replaces the reference’s opaque cloth. Only merchant size F is sold and available; body measurements and lining coverage are not stated. Other styled garments/accessories are excluded. USD currency confirmed in merchant page data. Dispatch time unstated.

Black 100% cotton full-length walking skirt with adjustable button waistband. Plain, slim silhouette replaces the reference’s layered ruffles and embroidery. Skirt only; no hoop is required or included. Only XS and 3X are currently available; all other sizes sold out. Merchant gives approximate lengths of 41 inches in S and 43 inches in 2X, but those sizes are not offered here. Dispatch time unstated.

Black unlined 100% cotton twill skirt, about 40 inches long, with elastic waist and back ruffles creating a bustle. Ruffles run mainly at the back; it lacks the reference’s front embroidery and angled layered overskirt. Skirt only; shown hoop underskirt is sold separately and is optional. S, M, L, XL and 2X are available; XS and 3X are sold out. Dispatch time unstated.
